verdict.rationale: Carta documents a first-party endpoint to create draft option grants, which it defines as grants still being finalized or not yet approved by the board. An agent can call it using OAuth client-credentials access that needs no per-user consent, so it can draft grants and leave them pending board approval. missing for 10: endpoint is v1alpha1 (alpha stability), only option grants are evidenced (not other security types), no documentation of how drafts surface in the board-consent workflow, the MCP plugin appears query-only, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
